title: Predicting the Direction Movement of Financial Time Series Using Artificial Neural Network and Support Vector Machine
idea: Can an ANN model outperform an SVM model in predicting the direction of daily Nasdaq-100 index movements using technical indicators derived from trading data?

title: The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions
idea: Can an AI trading agent maintain high rule adherence during different market conditions?

title: Black–Scholes Pricing and Market Mispricing of XSP European Index Options
idea: Short (sell) near‑ATM XSP calls that have a high absolute relative pricing error (e.g., ARPE > 30%) and buy the corresponding puts of similar moneyness, betting that the market will correct the call overprice while the put is fairly priced.

title: OPTIMAL INVESTMENT STRATEGIES FOR CONTROLLING DRAWDOWNS
idea: Scale daily exposure to Nasdaq futures (or QQQ) in proportion to the surplus (current equity curve minus α times its running maximum). Set α≈0.8 and exposure = k·(W‑αM)/W, with k calibrated to target a given volatility.
